purpose: Standalone disconnected-load P1.6 control-voltage test, not pump detection or a powered pump test
button: MSP S2 / P1.1; not the Zumo button
expected_behavior: Debounced press and release raises P1.6 and red LED1 for about 3.003 seconds, then lowers them. Another press cancels early; startup/held buttons cannot cause repeated pulses.
expected_high_voltage: Approximately board VCC (3.3 V); not physically measured
watchdog: Reset-mode ACLK watchdog about 1 second, serviced outside the pulse timer ISR
hardware_setup_confirmed_by_user: Zumo motor power OFF, pump and pump battery disconnected, MSP USB connected

installation.initial_usb_error: Windows descriptor request failure and TI No USB FET found; no programming occurred during that attempt
installation.usb_resolution: User changed the USB cable; MSP application COM13 and debug COM14 reappeared as TI 2047:0013
installation.postload_check_note: Initial debugger expression could not resolve P1OUT. Read the mapped peripheral registers instead, reverified the programmed image, then confirmed idle LOW and resumed execution.
installation.next_step: User measures P1.6 to GND while pressing/releasing MSP S2; pump remains disconnected and motor power OFF. Restore supervisor before robot operation.
